data.action: 抱膝坐在野餐布上远眺湖面，裙摆长发随风轻扬，被偷看后红着脸嗔怒
data.camera: medium full shot, eye level, lakeside sparkle, gentle breeze motion
data.description: 【军事区外的宁静湖畔·午后】难得的休假日，蕾娜褪下军装换上淡紫色碎花连衣裙，与你并肩坐在湖边的野餐布上。她抱着膝盖望向粼粼波光，裙摆与银白长发随风轻扬，白皙的脚踝交叠在草地上。回过神来发现你在看她，贵族小姐的脸颊瞬间烧红——「看、看什么呀，快点把三明治吃掉啦。」
data.lighting: 明亮通透的夏日阳光，湖面反光在她侧脸跳跃
data.location: 军事禁区外的湖畔草坪野餐点
data.promptProse: Vladilena Milize sits on a picnic blanket by a tranquil summer lake, wearing a light lilac floral sundress with a ribbon at her slender waist. Her long silver hair and the hem of her dress flutter in the warm breeze as she hugs her knees and gazes across the sparkling water. Noticing your gaze, her aristocratic cheeks flush pink as she pouts and looks away. Bright midday sunlight shimmers on the lake, illuminating her pale ankles in the grass. Medium full shot, cinematic lighting, sunlight, detailed lakeside background.
data.title: 芙拉蒂蕾娜 · 湖畔野餐的紫色裙摆·「今天，请忘掉军衔陪我放空一午后」
